notes: Paste your Gemini key and the app confirms it out loud: one toast says Gemini key connected, and it fires for the paste itself rather than on every keystroke.
The key field now lives in one place only. Support keeps the AI Assistant chat and the contact address, and every link that mentions the key points at the Important tab.
The lyrics timing asks the model to do more and then checks its work against the song: the prompt counts the lines and demands exactly that many timestamped lines back.

The first line is placed where the singing actually starts, however long the musical intro is. The pinned 00:01 is gone, which is what sat the words a bar behind the voice on songs that open on music.
If the model drops lines it is asked once more with the count it owes, and an even split dressed up as a timing is refused in favour of the measured layout the song itself gives.
Every timestamp the model returns is then snapped onto the nearest real energy rise in the recording, in order, so a line a beat early or late lands on the voice.
